title: Inspect stored audio sample values
changes: Add collapsible PCM header and paginated signed-byte sample tables, sample index lookup and waveform click navigation without stopping playback.
Expose all 32 stored amplitudes, source offset and tone references for each CGB wave.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-audio-values-synthetic-s_dkk82o checked headers, paging, invalid indices, empty waves, canvas navigation and continuing playback. Earlier izxyk4hb failed due to a rounded synthetic click; klnybce8 isolated the adjacent bin and the corrected test passed.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-audio-values-local-bqrh1s5u checked 277 headers, 44744 values in 831 representative pages and both CGB waves with unchanged embedded data. Docker unit rom-data-viewer-audio-values-docker-j378b8gu matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: The local comparison used embedded data while the source dataset volume was unavailable. The views display stored data, not reconstructed original mixer behavior; native Windows was not tested. The primary debugging model and effort were not independently confirmed.
